text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fierce atmosphere of her first Tokyo 
Daishoten was like a raging whirlpool. 
Copano Rickey and the others found their 
emotions swallowed into that giant vortex.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she was tossed around at every turn 
today, she resolved to grow even stronger 
and challenge it again next year.
